title: SELECT vitamin E and selenium trial: prostate-cancer-prevention supplements fail and vitamin E increases risk
summary: SELECT is promoted as a dietary-supplement prevention negative-result/harm record. The trial tested selenium and vitamin E supplementation for prostate-cancer prevention in more than 35,000 men. Initial monitoring found no prevention benefit and participants were told to stop supplements. Updated follow-up showed a statistically significant 17% relative increase in prostate cancer among men assigned to vitamin E alone compared with placebo.
